description: Aggregates pull requests, issues and error groups from configured sources into one reviewable surface.

required.reason: Read and write the source instances the user configured, read the list window assembled from them, and read and write the pins the user placed on entries.

description.fallback: Reads one bounded ordered window of pull requests, issues and error groups from the configured sources.

actions.title: Pin or unpin an entry

actions.title: Read the pinned entries

actions.title: Link an entry to a session
actions.description: Records that a pull request, issue or error group is being worked on in one session.

actions.title: Start a session on an entry

actions.title: Unlink an entry from a session

actions.title: Configure a source

actions.title: Read the sources you configured

actions.title: Read the durable facts of one entry
actions.description: Reads the configured connection one entry was observed through, and the sessions it is linked to.

actions.title: Read the saved views

actions.title: Save, update, delete or select a view

actions.title: Read the configured actions
actions.description: Reads the configured set of things a reader can start from a pull request, issue or error group.

actions.title: Add, change, remove or reorder an action
actions.description: Creates, renames, disables, reconfigures, removes or reorders one configured action.
